newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denmark launches 20 bln yen 5.8% yen/A$ samurais.
newsitem.headline: Denmark launches 20 bln yen 5.8% yen/A$ samurais.

text.p: Denmark on Friday launched 20 billion yen worth of 5.8 percent yen/Australian dollar dual-currency samurai bonds due January 13, 2000, lead-manager Nikko Securities said.
The bonds are priced at par, with coupon payments twice a year.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive A$5,760.37 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows:
AMT 20 bln yen COUPON 5.8% MATURITY Jan 13, 2000
TYPE dual-currency samurai PAY DATE Oct 14, 1996
ISS PRICE par SIGN DATE Sept 25, 1996
LEAD MANAGER Nikko Securities Co Ltd
LEAD TRUSTEE Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd
